article.description: Nathan Hoover scored 22 points with four 3-pointers and Chevez Goodwin's dunk with two minutes left gave Wofford the lead for good, beating Samford 67-62 on Wednesday night.
article.headline: Hoover, Goodwin help spark Wofford to 67-62 win at Samford
article.linkText: Hoover, Goodwin help spark Wofford to 67-62 win at Samford
article.story: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. -- Nathan Hoover scored 22 points with four 3-pointers and Chevez Goodwin's dunk with two minutes left gave Wofford the lead for good, beating Samford 67-62 on Wednesday night. Goodwin finished with 18 points and nine rebounds for Wofford (10-6, 2-1 Southern Conference) in a game that was tied 10 times in the second half, and the final period was a one-possession game until the very end. Trevor Stumpe added 11 points. and Storm Murphy had seven rebounds and four assists for the Terriers. After falling behind 35-32 at the half, Wofford outscored Samford 35-27 in the second half and scored the game's last six in the come-from-behind win. The 27 second-half points, on 9-of-29 shooting, marked a season low for Samford. Brandon Austin had 16 points for the Bulldogs (8-9, 2-1). Josh Sharkey added 15 points, six rebounds and six assists while Robert Allen scored 13 points. Wofford matches up against The Citadel at home on Saturday.
